d01-slate.note: A slate leaning on the tent pole at the mouth of a tent, a row of chalk marks for each of the other tents. People and the slate are added in the image pass.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic late-afternoon photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms and props where they are, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground becomes real limestone, scree, scrub and dry grass. Shields are plain round bronze, no emblem. One small bleached-linen tent on a hillside clearing, its shield leaning beside it, a chest and a basket by the tent. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its mercenary's dress exactly (oxblood red tunic and cloak, linen corslet, bronze greaves) and its tent. He kneels alone at the tent's mouth with a plain unframed slab of dark grey slate, no wooden frame, propped against the tent pole, three rows of short white chalk strokes across it, rubbing out one mark with his thumb. No other people, no fire. Deep focus. Nothing modern.
